sections.label: Infrastructure & Utilities
sections.summary: Overhead conductor clearances and transformer pad clearances are not adequately documented or verified on the plans, including missing surveyor elevations, building dimensions, and bollard protection. Construction logistics requirements, utility pole locations, and underground utility coordination need to be added to achieve compliance.

sections.label: Street Trees & Landscaping
sections.summary: Tree species, heights, and clearances to overhead lines and utilities lack required verification and documentation. Root barrier requirements and Austin Energy approval need to be obtained and shown on the landscape plan.
